name: camphor (-)- + menthol
uses: USES: Aid for temporary local relief of minor pain in muscles or joints.
otcwarn: STOP USE AND ASK A DOCTOR IF: Condition worsens Redness is present Irritation develops Symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up occur again within a few days You experience signs injury, such as pain, swelling or blistering where the product was applied.
